description: This is a Python module implementing repository classes for database operations in a sports live stream backend. It encompasses classes for users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, and highlights, encapsulating database interactions and data access logic.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Base class providing common database operations for derived repositories.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository for user management including creation, lookup, and updates.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository for user profile operations such as create, retrieve, and update.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository managing match data retrieval, including upcoming, live, and more matches.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository for event data access, supporting filtering and retrieval.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Handles emoji data, reactions, and summaries related to events/matches.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Manages highlight records including fetching and featured highlights.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database, normalizing roles and handling preferences.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates user data based on provided UserUpdate object.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a user profile with provided data.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a profile associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by its unique profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates profile data with new values.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of matches, with optional filters for status and sport type.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Gets detailed match info by its ID.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all currently ongoing live matches.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches upcoming matches within specified days.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Provides additional matches with variety, excluding specified IDs.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of events with optional sport and featured filtering.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves event details by event ID, including associated matches.

methods.name: get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of active emojis, with fallback for limited schema.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches an emoji by its ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str, created_at: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Adds an emoji reaction from a user to an event/match.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Summarizes reactions for an event, including counts and top emojis.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves highlights, optionally filtered by match ID.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a highlight by its ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Retrieves most recent and popular featured highlights.

methods.name: __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: unavailable
